title: Generalized Bicycle Codes as Cyclic Submodules and their Automorphism Structure
summary: Automorphisms of quantum codes, when they exist, offer a pathway toward fault-tolerant gate implementation via qubit relabeling. Although useful, the conditions under which automorphisms appear in a given code remain poorly understood. In this paper, we develop an algebraic framework for systematically analyzing and engineering automorphisms in Generalized Bicycle (GB) codes.
